meta.name: Capitol Hill, Seattle
meta.source: OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API; elevation from USGS 3DEP (public domain)
meta.note: Real map data. Contributor names, uids, changesets and timestamps were removed. Incline is the steepest stretch of at least 12 m along each edge, from a 1 m lidar DEM.

tags.note: Unsure if this is "officially" part of Nagle Place. The plaza was referred to as an extension of Nagle Place during construction, but I don't believe there's any signage referring to it as such now.
